name: Miranda del Castañar (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of white, red and white with a broad red central stripe, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Miranda del Castañar (a chestnut tree on yellow, a black bend and chequy of blue and white).
history: The arms of Miranda del Castañar were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 7 December 1996; the municipal flag was approved on 28 April 1997 and is square, of proportion 1:1, tierced per pale of white, red and white.
